tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development and release alike, with no build type exempt. This is reinforced by the recorded rule of HTTPS everywhere with no exceptions, so no host, internal or otherwise, is carved out to use plain HTTP or to skip certificate checks.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with one paragraph. It says TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development and release alike. It adds that the recorded "HTTPS everywhere, no exceptions" decision means no host is exempt.

I checked the two current decisions with `muninn show` before writing. The earlier record that verification was disabled in dev builds is retired, so I left it out.
